def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((v for v in set(grid[0]) if v != 0), None)
    # Separators form full rows/columns; panel size is 4x4 here.
    row_bands=[]; col_bands=[]
    r=0
    while r<h:
        if all(x==sep for x in grid[r]): r+=1; continue
        start=r
        while r<h and not all(x==sep for x in grid[r]): r+=1
        row_bands.append((start,r))
    c=0
    while c<w:
        if all(grid[y][c]==sep for y in range(h)): c+=1; continue
        start=c
        while c<w and not all(grid[y][c]==sep for y in range(h)): c+=1
        col_bands.append((start,c))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in row_bands:
        # color indicated by the nonzero object in first panel
        color=next((grid[y][x] for y in range(r0,r1) for x in range(col_bands[0][0],col_bands[0][1]) if grid[y][x] not in (0,sep)),0)
        # template is the nonempty panel not in first column
        template=None
        for c0,c1 in col_bands[1:]:
            cells=[(y-r0,x-c0) for y in range(r0,r1) for x in range(c0,c1) if grid[y][x] not in (0,sep)]
            if cells:
                template=cells
                break
        if template:
            for c0,c1 in col_bands:
                for dy,dx in template:
                    out[r0+dy][c0+dx]=color
    return out
PY
